title: UI / Distill the experience

location.series: Elvis Dinh / Instagram brand design system / project year 2022

slide_intent: Carry only the product cues needed for recognition when moving a digital experience into a large physical format.
strategic_value: A familiar post frame can identify Instagram while allowing the creator image to dominate.
demonstration: A billboard displays a rotated portrait with account identity, glyph and simplified interaction symbols.
practical_value: Compare which interface cues survive the change from a small screen to a roadside billboard.

content_islands.name: Billboard image
content_islands.spec: Fill the billboard with the reclining subject’s image.

content_islands.name: Distilled interface
content_islands.spec: Keep the account cue at upper left, glyph at upper right and a few interaction marks near the edges.

reference_purposes.Application: The billboard translates a post-like interface into an outdoor placement.
reference_purposes.Expression: The image and sparse white UI cues preserve a recognizable Instagram character.
